g.text: layouts/colemak-dh.cfg · macOS · Physical positions labeled in the upper-left of every key
Large label = tap output. Blue keys add hold modifiers; purple keys are media controls.
Home-row holds: Ctrl · Option · Shift · Cmd | Cmd · Shift · Option · Ctrl
Caps: tap Esc / hold Ctrl. Shift: tap for one-shot Shift (1s timeout), or hold normally.
Green = navigation action. Red = disabled. Gray = unintercepted physical key, passed through.
H/J/K/L: arrows · U/I: previous/next tab (Ctrl+Shift+Tab / Ctrl+Tab) · ;: Enter · F: F13
Shift, Caps and intercepted home-row modifiers are blocked in Nav. F13 needs an external binding.
Tab-switch shortcuts depend on the app. Unlisted keys pass through; Nav coverage differs between configs.
